title: Shop deletion choices
decision: During the 30 days the shop works as before except that reminders stop, no new customer can be linked and the subscription review skips it; the owner is told when deletion is asked for, cancelled and done, and customers are sent nothing; the shop row is kept as a tombstone named erased and measurement rows stay; the waiting period is counted by the database clock so the application cannot shorten it; stored file objects are to be deleted when the file store exists
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 33
rationale: BR-25 gives the 30 days and the erasure but not what works meanwhile or what remains
